hints.title: THE TUNNEL BORERS
hints.text: Below run two tunnel boring machines - cousins of the four TBMs that bored most of the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel, the world's longest rail tunnel. They eat rock, ice, even boulders. Never stand in front of the cutter.

hints.title: RIDE THE WAKE
hints.text: Wait for the borer to pass, then walk the fresh tunnel behind it. The ore it spares is left on the floor for you - and one dig upward is always an escape.

hints.title: STAMPEDE
hints.text: Spiders feel the borers' tremors and come running. The machines do not care. Stay out of the stampede.

hints.title: FIVE HUNDRED ELEPHANTS
hints.text: Each Gotthard TBM weighed about 3,000 tonnes - as much as 500 elephants - and bored 10 to 20 metres on a typical day, for years. Answer the wall question to open the logic door - the exit lies beyond.
